correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def split_rot(srcset,pr,pc,n):
 o=set()
 for r,c in srcset:
  if c==pc:o.add((r,c));continue
  p=(pr+(c-pc),pc-(r-pr)) if c<pc else (pr-(c-pc),pc+(r-pr))
  o.add((foldn(p[0],n),foldn(p[1],n)))
 return o
